doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Back to Luchenbach's with Big Eye Louie and Rodgers
summary: Back at Luchenbach's she had Big Eye Louie Nelson and Rodgers, and Octave Crosby; they try to recall a pianist.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: But it's always a thing up there.
But you don't remember any of them. What's Buddy's song? Yeah, I mean did he feature? No, I don't, I don't know. It's been so long.
Things like fave and dryer and all that stuff I guess. Yeah, you said what kind of stuff up there. Well, let's see. You came back from Bonkhead and went to, where, where'd you say you went?
Went back home doing folks home to Lutton's. Back to Lutton's. Back to Lutton's.
And who'd you have down there?

I had Big Eye Louie, Rodgers. You had Lucian in four a while too. I had Lucian, we had Lucian on drums but I mean. I left Rodgers, Big Eye Louie. And, uh, well I left, I turned the job over to Rodgers. See, but Louie was working there, see. So Rodgers just looked around and got the other piano player. But I think, what was his name, Octavia? Octave. Octave. Not Octave in there.
You might be talking to him, he played up in the chorus too. Yeah.
Yeah, Well, he was down there, see.
Who is Sadie Crosby now? I don't know Sadie. I heard somebody, she sang on radio, play piano. Sadie Crosby, playing piano.
What do you mean there was a piano play here by that night? Sadie Crosby.
I don't know Sadie, I know play piano, Sadie Goodson. That was my sister. What was her name?

I can't call her name too. I worked with her. I was an orphan over there too. I could go to T. I can't call her. Oh, what do you mean there? What do you mean there? Well, nothing more than me to Barton. Four minutes away up in town. I can't call her name because she played. I want to get his feet up there too. I can't call her name. I can't call her name. I just can't call her name.
Who is Lucian now? What was his name? Bob Grant. Bob Grant.
Paul Bob Grant's brother. Paul Bob Grant's brother. Oh, I see.
